Q: Can we compile PF (physical file) directly from IFS location? A:

No, nor do I except IBM to bother to support it.

Instead, they expect you to use SQL scripts to define your PF/tables (LF/views or indexes), which can be stored and run from the IFS with various tooling, such as RUNSQLSTM.

Q: SpringBoot JPA Entity Manager flush and clear functions helps in importing large data sets faster A:

The proper way to do it, from a JPA perspective, would be to split up the work into smaller individual transactions. The flush and clear you do is kind of a scuffed workaround to solve only one problem of the package of problems you will be dealing with; namely that the first level cache of the EntityManager balloons out of proportions. By clearing it, you resolve that.

But you still have an active transaction which will not shrink in size, and that might at some point still break your system if you hit some arbitrary limit.

Q: PowerShell variable not outputting property A:

It's a typo. You meant "$($IP.Name) is ... " instead of "$($IP4.Name) is ..."

Don't worry about it; we've all done it. The number of times I've spent ages staring at code I know should work just fine, only to finally spot a misplaced pluralization or similar... Just yesterday I was doing some fiddly bitwise operations I just couldn't get right, only to finally realized I had -bor instead of -bxor. (Now I have to figure out why the powershell took 54 minutes to run over the data, where equivalent C# only took 30 seconds).

Q: HTML CSS Support extension in VsCode isn't giving Bootstrap property hints for styling A: 
"css.styleSheets": [{cdn_link}],

Add the Bootrstrap CDN link in VsCode settings.json like above, if you're using Bootstrap through CDN. Otherwise the bootstrap installed location, if installed through a package manager like NPM. This worked for me following the documentation of the extension: https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=ecmel.vscode-html-css
